name: @newsun/writing-peer-review
description: Independent student peer-review application; teacher grading remains in WriteAscend.

scripts.worker:check: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && wrangler deploy --env development --dry-run
scripts.worker:check:staging: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run
scripts.worker:check:production: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run
